mapper.select: select id, name, name_cn, discipline, 0 as program_count from nad_major where id = #{id}
select id, name, name_cn, discipline, 0 as program_count from nad_major where name = #{name}

select m.id, m.name, m.name_cn, m.discipline, (select count(*) from nad_program_major pm where pm.major_id = m.id) as program_count from nad_major m
and (m.name like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or m.name_cn like concat('%', #{q}, '%'))
and m.discipline = #{discipline}
order by m.name asc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_major (name, name_cn, discipline, create_by, create_time) values (#{name}, #{nameCn}, #{discipline}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from nad_program_major where major_id = #{id}
mapper.update: update nad_program_major set major_id = #{toId} where major_id = #{fromId} and id > 0
